calendarFaqs.q: When does CPS start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Chicago Public Schools starts the 2026–27 K–12 school year on Monday, August 24, 2026. Preschool students begin Tuesday, August 25.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CPS Winter Vacation in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: CPS Winter Vacation runs Monday, December 21, 2026, through Friday, January 1, 2027. January 4 is a professional development day, so students do not return that Monday.

calendarFaqs.q: When do CPS students return after Winter Vacation?
calendarFaqs.a: Students return Tuesday, January 5, 2027. The published Winter Vacation ends January 1, but CPS schedules a professional development day with no student attendance on Monday, January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CPS Spring Vacation in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: CPS Spring Vacation runs Monday, March 22, through Friday, March 26, 2027. Students return Monday, March 29.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for CPS in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day for K–12 students is Friday, June 11, 2027. Preschool students finish Thursday, June 10. The first and last K–12 school days are both full days.

calendarFaqs.q: Which CPS student non-attendance days fall outside major vacations?
calendarFaqs.a: Outside holidays and major vacations, CPS lists professional development days on September 25, November 11, January 4 and 29, February 23, and April 6. Parent-teacher conference days on November 2 and April 12 are also student non-attendance days.

calendarFaqs.q: Does CPS publish separate preschool dates?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Preschool students begin August 25, 2026, one day after K–12 students, and finish June 10, 2027, one day before the K–12 last day.

calendarFaqs.q: Can emergency days extend the CPS school year?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. CPS marks June 15–17 and June 21–22, 2027, as emergency days when school may be in session if student days fall below the state requirement. Check CPS before making firm plans for those dates.

sourceReviewSummary: District PDF last updated March 5, 2026. MySchoolDates reviewed the current CPS calendar page and Family Calendar on August 19, 2026.
sourceReviewDetails: CPS calls the source document its Family Calendar for elementary and high schools, and this page follows the district’s terminology.

The review confirmed the September 24 Q1 progress-report date, the January 4 professional development day, the January 5 student return, the 42/45/42/47 quarter totals, and the June 15–17 and June 21–22 emergency days.
School-specific bell schedules, testing dates, athletics, ceremonies, transportation notices and program calendars remain outside the districtwide Family Calendar.
